posts.text: Approaching midtown. Time to lock in
Macy’s is closed until 10, despite the McDs website saying the McDs inside should be open. A conundrum. I think I’m allowed to skip
Canal St still closed for remodel. They were supposed to be done yesterday
Restaurants are starting go get busy with lunch
